source_geography: United States (O*NET-SOC representative occupations; not official MASCO-to-O*NET crosswalk)

scoring_policy.current_backend_weight: Always the unmodified careers.json required_skills value (1–4).
scoring_policy.direct_general_skill_rating: For directly equivalent and unsuppressed O*NET Skills IM only, a proposed project conversion min(4, floor(IM)); not automatically adopted.
scoring_policy.related_occupation_tasks: Task IM is task importance, NOT skill importance; no numerical skill-score derivation.
scoring_policy.missing_evidence: Retain team weight; null is unknown, not zero.
scoring_policy.not_ai_risk: Neither skill nor task importance measures AI exposure or replacement probability.

warnings: Source rating dates vary; preserve dates per rating/task and do not imply all evidence was measured this year.
All task-to-skill links are human-reviewed interpretations, including partial links; not official crosswalks.
The US Registered Nurses occupational tasks do not define Malaysian legal nursing scope.
Software-specific technologies and other unmatched concepts must not receive invented O*NET general-skill ratings.
This evidence output changes no career weights, matching logic, forecasts, or scenario multipliers.
